A rate is a READING with a date and a source — where sources disagree both readings stay, and the ledger takes the reading that matches the tier/resolution it is asked for: an exact-resolution reading beats a later null-resolution one, and among equals the latest read wins. A null resolution on a reading means the source did not state one, so it matches any.

_house.ruling_2026_10_03_provider: ruled 2026-10-03: after the same two Creator-A tests through every provider that sells Omni (fal $0.24 / 33-47 s, Google direct $0.29 / 22-38 s, Higgsfield ~$0.35 / 45 s-3 min; identical inputs; machine/omni_bench.py, runs/video-production/brand-b/kzn03-face-scrub-clean/clips/bench/bench.json): "go with fal for sure". Omni runs on fal ($0.03/s at 360p): image-to-video for talking, reference-to-video (picture + up to 3 x 3 s of BLURRED swipe) for movement.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_voice: SUPERSEDED for voice: the approved read is fitted to the lips (align_take.py), speech-to-speech is not used — components/generative-model-house/MODEL-HOUSE.md. History: ruled 2026-10-03: after hearing Section 1 two ways (A: the clip model speaks the line, ElevenLabs speech-to-speech turns it into the cast voice; B: the approved take time-aligned to the lips), both with the crisp finish: "version a actually sounds like the avatar looks". On-camera lines = A + the crisp finish (machine/omni.py CRISP). Also: "even the doctor's voice sounded better with omni".
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_voice_first_retired: ruled 2026-10-03: on the voice-first workflow it replaces: the audio was made first only to cut dead air before the scenes were made; "it's actually just easier to generate the voices directly from the model itself, and then we can adjust the voice later. Also, the lip sync's already done … it's just literally just changing the voice." Dead air: clips made to storyboard length, trimmed to first/last spoken word by the clip's own word timings.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_face_lock: ruled 2026-10-03: on the Creator-A clips. Fix in the chain: clips made at 1080p (no upscale), each person's eyes/marks from their casting spec written into every prompt, a person on screen locks the approved picture as the first frame (no reference mode), and a face lock check (eye colour vs the approved picture, face model when it answers) remakes a drifting clip once.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_sounds: ruled 2026-10-03: on the Creator-A clips: sounds that are not words ("umms", "hmm", "uh-huh", "mm-hmm") do not come out clean when Omni mouths them. "We should just keep that as a separate sound, not worry about lip sync there. Obviously, keep her head nod, but we don't need to put in the vocals with it." In the chain: a line that is only a sound is never said on camera; the person on screen nods, lips closed; the sound is made in the cloned voice and laid in at the edit. A sound at the start or end of a spoken line is cut from what Omni says and made the same way.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_no_handoffs: ruled 2026-10-03:. Root cause of the Creator-A face drift: clips started from the previous clip's last frame (a copy of a copy). 17 clips from the approved picture held; all 10 handed-on clips drifted, worse each hand-off. In the chain: a person on screen means every clip starts from the approved picture; no hand-offs.
_house.ruling_2026_10_03_no_invented_speech: 3 Oct (Creator-A edit): the clip prompt said "Someone off camera talks now" and Omni invented the off-camera lines ("Apply this gentle scrub…", "We'll trace the laser…") in 4 clips; the words check only confirmed the scripted line was there. Off-camera stretches now say nobody speaks; the real line is its own track. The edit keeps a clip's sound only across its scripted words.

Fix in the chain: clips made at 1080p (no upscale), each person's eyes/marks from their casting spec written into every prompt, a person on screen locks the approved picture as the first frame (no reference mode), and a face lock check (eye colour vs the approved picture, face model when it answers) remakes a drifting clip once.
_history_provenance.._house.ruling_2026_10_03_sounds: the owner, 2026-10-03, on the Creator-A clips: sounds that are not words ("umms", "hmm", "uh-huh", "mm-hmm") do not come out clean when Omni mouths them. In the chain: a line that is only a sound is never said on camera; the person on screen nods, lips closed; the sound is made in the cloned voice and laid in at the edit.
